2011 Belgian National Championship
Brussels Outpost Gamestore
March 13, 2011
30 players

Peter Bouwman's Tournament Winning Deck

Deck Name: Freaky Politicians
Author: Peter Bouwman
Description:
An old skool Ventrue deck focussing on putting blood on uncontrolled
vampires or use those cards to bleed heavily. Older versions had more
freak drives. Thats were the name came from. This deck won the 2011
Belgian National Championship on March 13, 2011 in the Outpost Gamestore
in Brussels.

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body: I was asking Jussi (as administrator/creator for Secret Library) a while ago to separate author from player (i.e. adding an additional field), especially for the TWDs. But he refused on the grounds, that it is a rare case, that player and author are separate persons. So as of today SL only knows the field "author".

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
It can be changed in a future version of the Secret Library, but as long as I have work to do in here, I have absolutely no time to make code-level changes to the Secret Library, except for fixing critical errors.

And as for it making no sense: It makes sense if you think of it as TWD repository. Or would you ask the TWD to display the actual assembler of the deck, before the player of the deck? The player might not have written the actual deck, but he wrote the story that made it win.

Jussi Hattara
Webmaster Extraordinaire
Finnish  Politics!

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
> jhattara wrote:
> And as for it making no sense: It makes sense if you think of it as TWD repository. Or would you ask the TWD to display the actual assembler of the deck, before the player of the deck? The player might not have written the actual deck, but he wrote the story that made it win.
>
If you use a deck that someone else designed and didn't change anything in it I do think that you aren't the author and you NEED to acknowledge the deck's original designer.

If you use someone else's design and tweak it it would be very polite to acknowldge the original designer. The less you change the deck, the more you need to mention the original designer.

For example, I think that people who have been using "Girls" deck have tended very often to acknowledge the original designers.

Finnish  Politics!

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
Of course the original designer should be credited, but in TWDA the player goes before (and the designer should be mentioned in the Description field). No matter how good deck you play, the player himself plays a significant part in VTES.

I acknowledge that this is a design flaw in the Secret Library, but while there is only one field for the author, TWD should be credited to the player first.

Jussi Hattara
Webmaster Extraordinaire
Finnish  Politics!
